title: In-flight output metrics, trace linking, and redaction workflow for streamed responses
creator: Marco Li
description:
Goal: Provide a low-overhead instrumentation and redaction workflow for streamed responses that preserves per-segment (microframe) metrics and trace correlation while preventing PII leakage and maintaining structured output compatibility for existing SDKs and downstream consumers.

Motivation:
- Customers running chat/streaming workloads need per-segment latency/cost signals to tune batching and cache policies without ingesting full user payloads.
- Traces must be linkable from initial request -> token/segment spans -> eventual tool/function-call spans to support root-cause analysis for high-latency segments.
- Redaction must be safe for progressively emitted structured outputs (JSON-lines / partial JSON) and not break client parsers or tool call boundaries.

Scope:
- Instrument per-emission microframes (configurable window: bytes/ tokens / tokens-or-duration) with aggregated metrics: emit_count, microframe_processing_ms, kv_cache_hits, tool_call_marker boolean, and error_flag.
- Attach a lightweight 8-byte provenance token per microframe for trace correlation (trace root + microframe seq hashed). No user text in telemetry.
- Implement a streaming redaction filter that runs in the publish path and supports: regex scrub, entropy-based PII heuristics, deterministic hashing for identifiers, and structured-field-aware redaction to avoid truncating JSON values mid-emit.
- Provide compatibility shim for older SDKs: emit a single metadata event at start with redaction-level and provenance-mode, fall back to legacy stream markers if client doesn't support microframe headers.

Out of scope for this ticket:
- Full per-token telemetry (too high overhead), fine-grained per-tool debug dumps (handled by follow-up optional debug mode).
acceptance_criteria: Per-microframe metrics emitted to telemetry pipeline with <2% added p50 latency on p99 streaming requests
Trace spans created for microframes and linkable to request root in Jaeger/Grafana traces
Redaction pipeline removes or replaces PII without producing invalid JSON for structured streaming outputs
SDK compatibility shim returns start-of-stream metadata when client is older, documented in console and release notes
E2E test that simulates tool-calls across a stream and verifies span stitching and redacted payloads
technical_notes: We choose 8-byte provenance token (RFC-style) to keep headers tiny and avoid leaking user content. Token = HMAC(trace_id || microframe_seq, telemetry_key) truncated to 8 bytes.
Metric cardinality mitigation: microframe metrics are aggregated by provenance token + model + route, and we sample full-text captures at 1% by default. Sampling config is per-customer adjustable.
Redaction order: structured-field-aware replacer -> regex masks -> hashing for IDs. This reduces chance of breaking partial JSON (we use a tokenizer that understands JSON fragments).

Backward compatibility: older SDKs receive a start metadata event with redaction_level and a single stream_trace_id. New SDKs get per-frame headers with microframe_token. Server will synthesize legacy markers when needed.
Performance: implement redaction and provenance tagging in C++ publish path with a fast path that only adds headers when telemetry is enabled for the route.
updates: 2025-02-14: Initial ticket created by Marco Li. Draft design doc linked. Proposed microframe boundaries: 8KB or 200 tokens or 250ms, whichever comes first.

2025-02-19: Design review with PM and DX. Decided to prefer deterministic hashing over plain removal for identifiers used by downstream routing (keeps referential integrity). PM requests opt-in config per workspace.
2025-02-25: Security review kickoff with Sec. Sec asked for HMAC-based provenance token and explicit KMS rotation plan. Marked security_review_required = true.
2025-02-27: Prototype implemented for tagging in publish worker (benchmarks on c6 GPU infra). End-to-end p50 added latency 0.7ms, p99 1.9ms for synthetic stream workloads with telemetry enabled.
2025-03-02: UX/SDK meeting: Node/Python SDKs will treat metadata event 0 as capability handshake. SDKs to ignore per-frame headers unless capability flag present. Sofia to open SDK tickets.

2025-03-03: Started integration tests against telemetry ingest (staging). Found edge case where redaction removed closing quote in mid-stream JSON when regex applied before structure-aware tokenizer; fixed ordering and added token boundary checks.
work_items: WIP-1: Implement microframe header emit and provenance token generation in publish worker
WIP-2: Build structure-aware redactor library and integrate into publish fast-path
WIP-3: Telemetry aggregation job: ingest microframe metrics and roll up by route/period
WIP-4: Add trace span stitching in tracing bridge and expose trace links in Console
WIP-5: SDK compatibility shim and release notes
